cases.title: Messages opens the project messaging view
cases.expected: The project's messages view or panel opens without leaving the project context.
cases.setup: Remain on the counter-offer-sent project screen.
gaps: The exact project's messages view or panel opening without leaving the project context cannot be reliably asserted.

cases.title: Settings opens project settings
cases.expected: The project settings view or panel opens.
cases.setup: Remain on the counter-offer-sent project screen.
gaps: Whether the project settings view or panel opens after clicking Settings.

cases.title: Actions opens the available project actions
cases.expected: An actions menu opens and shows only actions available for the current project state.
cases.setup: Remain on the counter-offer-sent project screen.
gaps: The exact list of actions that must be available or absent for the current project state.

cases.title: Ask Clara redirects when awarding analysis is requested
steps: Wait for the request to complete.
cases.expected: The message "Awarding initiated successfully, redirecting to awarding flow..." appears, then the browser navigates to the returned redirect_url.
cases.setup: Use a project where the Clara todo action is analyze_data and the response contains a redirect_url.
gaps: Exact equality between the browser URL and the dynamically returned redirect_url

cases.title: Project link returns to the project list context
cases.expected: The project context or project list page opens, and the counter-offer details screen is no longer displayed.
cases.setup: Remain on the counter-offer-sent project screen.
